products.name: Auction Lot Intake Gate
products.product: A focused auction lot intake and catalog readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent auction houses and regional specialty auctioneers
products.problem: Consignor authority, object identity, condition, estimate, reserve, photography, description, location, and sale assignment are reviewed in different tools.
products.valueProposition: Turns auction lot intake and catalog readiness into a visible operating queue so every published lot has complete authority, identity, commercial terms, location, and catalog approval.
products.topic: auction lot intake and catalog readiness
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets auction lot intake and catalog readiness software, auction lot intake and catalog readiness tracker, auction lot intake and catalog readiness template, and auction lot intake and catalog readiness checklist searches.

products.name: Bidder Payment and Release
products.product: A focused auction bidder payment and lot release workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent auction houses and regional specialty auctioneers

products.valueProposition: Turns auction bidder payment and lot release into a visible operating queue so every purchased lot leaves custody only after payment and release authority are verified.

products.audience: independent auction houses and regional specialty auctioneers
